title: Perioral motor stabilization without classical proprioception: A trigeminofacial force-balance model
title_zh: 缺乏经典本体感觉的口周运动稳定化：一种三叉-面神经力平衡模型
abstract: Voluntary perioral movements, including speech articulation, deliberate lip posturing, and postural stabilization during oral closure, require motor precision despite the absence of muscle spindles and proprioceptive receptors in perioral musculature. The facial nerve is purely efferent, providing no direct sensory return. How the motor system achieves stable control under these constraints has remained unresolved. We propose the Orofacial Region as Integrated System (ORIS) model as a mechanistic candidate tailored to voluntary and automatic segmental perioral behaviors. The model identifies cutaneous mechanoreception via the trigeminal nerve as the primary afferent channel for perioral motor stabilization and proposes that the controlled variable is the spatial equilibrium of dermal surface tension across the perioral sheet, monitored by slowly and fast-adapting mechanoreceptors concentrated in the perioral region. The orbicularis oris sphincter provides circumferential tensile stability against which directional muscles act, with the modiolus anguli oris serving as the primary force-transmission junction. Three testable predictions follow from this architecture. Clinical implications for facial motor rehabilitation are discussed.
abstract_zh: 自愿性口周运动，包括言语发音、有意识的口唇姿态以及口唇闭合时的姿态稳定化，都需要运动精度，尽管口周肌肉中没有肌梭和本体感觉受体。面神经纯粹是传出神经，不提供直接的感觉反馈。在受到这些约束的情况下，运动系统如何实现稳定控制一直未解决。我们提出口面积综合系统（ORIS）模型作为一种机制候选模型，专门针对自愿和自动的分节性口周行为。该模型将三叉神经传导的皮肤机械感受识别为口周运动稳定的主要传入通道，并提出控制变量是口周表面皮肤张力的空间平衡，该平衡由集中在口周区域的慢适应和快适应机械感受器监测。口轮匝肌括约肌提供环向张力稳定性，方向性肌肉在其上作用，口角模作为主要的力传递结节。该架构得出三项可检验的预测。讨论了面部运动康复的临床意义。
